entries.clue: Word in many California city names
Treated like it didn't exist, as gravity
One in an ancient Jewish sect
Based on deduction as opposed to experience
"Nor to their idle __ doth sight appear": Milton
Groups that get busy in Sept.
Hit the dirt on a diamond
Like a supermarket before a major storm, perhaps
It helps a team pull together
